content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JSSHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.jsshs.org. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital Society (JSSHS). It is a government job opportunity in the healthcare sector.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Senior Resident. These positions are available across various medical specialties.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this JSSHS recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 37 vacancies available for the Senior Resident posts across different departments at Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital Society.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for JSSHS Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the JSSHS Senior Resident recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their completed application forms to the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for JSSHS Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the Senior Resident posts is 17 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the walk-in date for JSSHS Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in assessment/interview date for the Senior Resident positions is 18 August 2026. Candidates should check the official notification for reporting details.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for Senior Resident posts at JSSHS?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Resident posts is 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates for JSSHS recruitment?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1000/-. SC/ST candidates pay Rs. 500/-, and PwBD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Senior Resident posts at JSSHS?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Resident posts will receive a salary of Rs. 67,700/- per month, along with other admissible allowances as per rules.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital Society?
faq.answer: The official website for Janakpuri Super Speciality Hospital Society (JSSHS) is www.jsshs.org. Candidates can visit this website for more details and updates.
